title: Idempotent Token Usage Ledger
prompt:
Implement `summarize_token_usage(events) -> list[tuple]`. Each valid event mapping has `request_id`, `model`, `status`, `prompt_tokens`, `cached_prompt_tokens`, and `completion_tokens`. Events arrive in order and a later event with the same `request_id` replaces that request's earlier record. The final record for a request is therefore the only one that may be counted.

Count only final records whose status is `'completed'`. Group them by model and return one tuple per model in lexicographic model order: `(model, completed_requests, prompt_tokens, cached_prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, billable_tokens)`. The token columns are sums across the model's counted requests. For one request, billable tokens are `prompt_tokens - cached_prompt_tokens + completion_tokens`; all numeric values are valid nonnegative integers and cached prompt tokens never exceed prompt tokens.

This is an idempotent usage report: a later failed or cancelled retry must remove an earlier completed version of the same request from the final totals. Do not mutate the event mappings.

example.reasoning: Only uncached prompt tokens plus generated completion tokens are billable.
